approaches.name: centralized housing information system for stock and needs
approaches.description: A unified digital system tracks housing stock and demand, including displaced persons, to guide investment decisions. Practices: centralized housing information system for stock and needs; Unified Housing Information and Analytical System for housing stock monitoring.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: housing stock and needs registry - cue: 'centralized housing information system' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: To support the creation of a private housing market, the law mandates the creation of market-enabling mechanisms, such as a centralized housing information system with details on the available housing stock and needs, thereby allowing the planning and identification of investment opportunities.

extra_evidence.text: Throughout, the law emphasizes digitalization and digital solutions, including digitizing records.

It also provided for the creation of a Unified Housing Information and Analytical System to monitor the housing stock and demand, as well as the development of a State Housing Policy Strategy to meet the needs of vulnerable groups and internally displaced persons, thereby ensuring the participation of the private sector in housing reconstruction.

category.rationale: Technological: the digital registry is the core mechanism, not a financing instrument

sector.rationale: Centralized housing information system for stock and needs directly serves housing construction.

adoption.rationale: Digital core: centralized housing information system | Innovative: market-enabling stock/needs registry replacing 1983 model | Category: Technological

approaches.innovation_basis: New service: housing stock and needs registry - cue: 'centralized housing information system'

approaches.name: unified emissions register for MRV reporting and verification
approaches.description: Requires monitoring, verification and improvement reports submitted through the unified national digital emissions register.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: digital register for emissions reporting and verification - cue: 'digital platform' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: It further mandates the submission of monitoring, verification, and improvement reports through the unified register of emissions (established through prior action 8), which serves as the national digital platform for emissions accounting.

extra_evidence.text: One of two ministerial orders (i) harmonizes how industrial installations report emissions data by specifying the structure, units, and indicators for carbon dioxide and other GHG emissions; and the other (ii) updates the methodology for calculating national GHG emissions to align with the International Panel for Climate Change and EU guidelines.
Expected results: Reignited MRV system, captured in the results framework as an increase in the share of production sites covered by the new MRV system to 60 percent.

sector.rationale: Unified emissions register for MRV reporting is a public administration regulatory function.
